description: A child theme of the default block theme with the design tokens in theme.json: a neutral palette and one accent, two font families, a type scale, a spacing scale and content widths. Fill the tokens from the design brief (blueprint frontend-design).

placeholders.slug: theme folder and text domain, e.g. book-club
placeholders.name: theme name, e.g. Book Club

next: Replace the palette, fonts and sizes with the design brief's values; bundle font files under assets/fonts/ and reference them in fontFace.
